important_findings: A premodern domestic tradition explicitly links short eaves with oblique rain striking walls; this is a real physical-form motif but not a numeric ancient design standard.
The phrase 簷水相射 / 水簷頭相射 contains a water/runoff object and cannot responsibly be generalized into every roof-pointing taboo.
Yingzao Fashi provides rich historical roof terminology and construction technique, but it is technical architectural evidence rather than auspiciousness evidence.
